JARVIS listens for your wake word, dictation, and voice commands. Recording only runs while you have it switched on.
JARVIS uses the camera to inspect objects, scan documents, and provide visual assistance.
JARVIS accesses your photos and documents vault when you ask to inspect, analyze, or attach media.
JARVIS saves generated visual reports, charts, and media directly to your Photos library.
JARVIS accesses your contacts for instant phone dialing, WhatsApp messaging, and SMS outreach.
JARVIS uses your location to answer questions about where you are and provide local weather and navigation.
JARVIS uses continuous background location to provide ambient spatial context, commute alerts, and geofenced automations.
JARVIS converts what you say into text so it can respond to spoken requests.
JARVIS connects to local Bluetooth accessories, wearables, and smart home IoT hubs.
JARVIS communicates with smart home hardware and Bluetooth peripherals.
JARVIS detects physical movement and gestures like shake-to-activate and device orientation.
JARVIS uses Face ID for biometric authentication to unlock private vaults and secure configurations.
JARVIS discovers and interacts with local smart devices and media hubs on your network.
